key: SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, AVG(usgs_northport_cfs) AS mean_usgs_cfs, AVG(nws_oliver_cfs) AS mean_nws_cfs, AVG(nws_oliver_cfs) - AVG(usgs_northport_cfs) AS diff_cfs, MAX(usgs_northport_stage_ft) - MIN(usgs_northport_stage_ft) AS stage_change_ft FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc >= '2026-10-19 05:00' AND hr_utc < '2026-10-25 05:00' AND usgs_northport_cfs IS NOT NULL AND nws_oliver_cfs IS NOT NULL GROUP BY local
